units.title: Add mill-turn GeometryTypes to HyperMillStrategyEngine + wire turning cycles
units.description: Add mill-turn geometry types to HyperMillStrategyEngine: OD_PROFILE, ID_PROFILE, FACE, GROOVE_OD, GROOVE_ID, GROOVE_FACE, THREAD_OD, THREAD_ID, PARTING, BORE, RECESS, CROSS_HOLE, CROSS_SLOT, OFF_CENTER_FEATURE. Wire 18+ turning cycles from HyperMillCycleCatalogEngine to these geometry types. Connect to TurningPrintToProgramEngine for G96/G97 CSS, TNRC tool nose radius comp, and turning force model.

units.title: Build hypermill-css-limit hook + mill-turn synchronization logic
units.description: Build hypermill-css-limit hook that validates constant surface speed (G96) against machine RPM limits: at small diameters, CSS requires very high RPM that may exceed machine max. Hook computes required RPM at minimum machining diameter and blocks if > machine max RPM (from MachineRegistry). Add mill-turn synchronization logic for C-axis milling operations during turning (cross-hole, cross-slot, off-center features).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: hypermill-css-limit hook blocks when RPM at min diameter > machine max
RPM calculation: RPM = (1000 * Vc) / (pi * D_min)
Machine max RPM from MachineRegistry (not hardcoded)
Mill-turn C-axis sync logic handles cross-hole and cross-slot
cam:hypermill_millturn_strategy action registered
4 unit tests: CSS safe, CSS block at small D, C-axis cross-hole, cross-slot

units.title: Wire MillTurnSwissPipelineEngine for multi-channel hyperMILL mill-turn

Create multi-channel operation sequencer that respects physical constraints (spindle direction, turret position, coolant routing).

sessions.title: Medical Domain — CoCr/PEEK Parameters + Dental Blank Router

smart_config.role: Medical Device Manufacturing Engineer + Biocompatible Materials Specialist

sessions.intent: Build medical domain support: CoCr-specific cutting parameters (ISO S group, high work hardening), PEEK-specific parameters (thermal ceiling, chip evacuation), dental blank router (disc vs block blank type → appropriate strategy), and biomedical cutting parameter validation.

units.title: Build CoCr + PEEK cutting parameter profiles with biomedical validation
units.description: Create HyperMillMedicalMaterialProfiles with: CoCr-specific parameters (ISO S group, kc1.1=2800, high work hardening correction factor, recommended speed 20-40 m/min, climb milling mandatory), PEEK-specific parameters (thermal ceiling 250C to avoid crystallinity change, low cutting force but stringy chips, sharp tools mandatory). Wire to MaterialBridge so that CoCr/PEEK material selections automatically get biomedical-validated cutting parameters.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: CoCr cutting params use kc1.1=2800 from constants.ts
PEEK thermal ceiling at 250C enforced
Work hardening correction factor applied for CoCr
Parameters validated against published biomedical machining data
A medical device machinist would accept these parameters
4 unit tests: CoCr roughing, CoCr finishing, PEEK drilling, PEEK milling

units.title: Build dental blank router (disc/block → strategy) + dental cycle wiring
units.description: Create HyperMillDentalBlankRouter that routes dental blank type (disc for crowns/bridges/abutments, block for single units) to appropriate hyperMILL dental strategy. Disc blanks use rotary A-axis positioning + 3+2 milling, block blanks use 5-axis simultaneous. Wire to HyperMillMultiAxisEngine dental strategies. Include material routing: zirconia (green state vs sintered), PEEK, CoCr, titanium (grade 5 for implants).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Dental blank router selects disc vs block strategy
Disc blank uses 3+2 positioning, block uses 5-axis simultaneous
4 dental materials routed (zirconia, PEEK, CoCr, Ti grade 5)
Zirconia green state uses higher speeds/lower forces than sintered
cam:hypermill_dental_route action registered
3 unit tests: zirconia disc, CoCr block, PEEK disc

units.title: Build biomedical cutting parameter validation hook + FDA/MDR compliance notes

Include compliance notes referencing FDA 21 CFR 820 and EU MDR Annex I essential requirements.
